Input: A set of N seed instructions S = {s i | i ∈ [N ]} manually crafted by human experts; A powerful LLM M (e.g., GPT-4o); Collected tasks T = {t i |i ∈ [|T |]} Initialize an instruction pool I ← S; for i ∈ |T | do Sample k examples {s ′ 1 , s ′ 2 , ..., s ′ k } from I; // Generate a new instruction s i using M through in-context learning: s i ← M(prompt with {s ′ 1 , s ′ 2 , ..., s ′ k }); //Append new instruction to pool: I = I ∪ {s i } ;
